$Comment: The Mithril rung: one piece of the finest vanilla gear, taken apart. A mithril piece is forged
with Void essence, and the table gives a little of that back as a find, which is the first
time most players see void come OUT of a thing rather than go in.
unmake_mithril is STATION_INPUT on '_Mithril' with CONTAINS, which catches every mithril piece
whatever its class: armor ids carry the metal in the middle (Armor_Mithril_Chest) and weapons
and tools at the end (Weapon_Sword_Mithril, Tool_Hatchet_Mithril), so a prefix would miss
half of them. The bar and the ore also contain the word, but neither is gear and the table
refuses both, so they can never fill the count. Qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX
so both tiers count. The step carries its own TextKey because the kind's default line would
Requires carries an Enchanting level gate beside the stations feature, one step up the
chain's level curve. No hand-in: TurnInId 'giver' still settles it at Orrin. Rewards sit in
Claim: Enchanting XP and a personal Enchanting boost token. Retune the Amount to ask for more
Name: Mithril_Unmade
